s: foreigners (uncircumcised in heart and flesh) is barred from sanctuary (the LORD's house) (including foreigners among the children of Israel)
q: No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

s: Levites bears their iniquity (for going astray after idols)
q: But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

s: Levites serves as ministers in the sanctuary (oversight at the gates, kill burnt offering and sacrifice for the people)
q: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house.

s: Levites is barred from priestly office and most holy things (may not come near the LORD)
q: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy

s: land of Israel has length twenty-five thousand reeds (offered when the land is divided by lot)
q: The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand.

s: Levites has possession size twenty-five thousand by ten thousand cubits (for twenty rooms)
q: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

s: house of Israel owns city possession (for the whole house of Israel) (five thousand wide and twenty-five thousand long)
q: You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

s: prince has possession land (inheritance of Israel) (on both sides of the holy allotment and city possession, west to east border)
q: What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city

s: prince must not oppress the people (princes shall give land to the house of Israel by tribes)
q: My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

s: prince provides sacrifices (burnt, meal, sin, peace, drink offerings) (at feasts, new moons, Sabbaths and appointed feasts)
q: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel.

s: just weights and measures requires just balances, just ephah, just bath
q: You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

s: just weights and measures defines ephah and bath one tenth of a homer (same measure)
q: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer.

s: just weights and measures defines shekel twenty gerahs
q: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs.

s: just weights and measures defines mina sixty shekels (twenty plus twenty-five plus fifteen)
q: Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

s: offering of grain, oil and lamb includes grain sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat and of barley
q: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

s: land of Israel has width ten thousand reeds (offered when the land is divided by lot)
q: The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand.

s: offering of grain, oil and lamb includes oil one tenth of a bath out of the cor
q: the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths

s: offering of grain, oil and lamb includes lamb one lamb out of two hundred (from well-watered pastures of Israel)
q: one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel

s: offering of grain, oil and lamb has purpose atonement (for meal, burnt and peace offerings)
q: for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them

s: offering of grain, oil and lamb is given by all the people of the land (for the prince)
q: All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

s: sacrifices (burnt, meal, sin, peace, drink offerings) has purpose atonement for the house of Israel (prepared by the prince)
q: He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.

s: cleansing of the sanctuary (first month) occurs on first day of the first month (with a young bull without defect)
q: In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

s: cleansing of the sanctuary (first month) is repeated on seventh day of the month (for everyone who errs or is simple)
q: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple.

s: cleansing of the sanctuary (first month) applies blood to door posts of the house, altar ledge corners, inner court gate posts (blood of the sin offering)
q: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

s: Passover occurs on fourteenth day of the first month (feast of seven days)
q: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

s: Passover requires unleavened bread (seven days)
q: a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

s: land of Israel is holy in all its border
q: It shall be holy in all its border all around.

s: Passover has daily burnt offering seven bulls and seven rams (without defect, plus a daily male goat as sin offering)
q: seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

s: Passover has meal offering an ephah per bull and ram (with a hin of oil to an ephah)
q: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

s: sanctuary (in the holy portion) is located in land of Israel
q: In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

s: sanctuary (in the holy portion) has holiness most holy
q: In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

s: sanctuary (in the holy portion) has site size five hundred by five hundred square (with fifty cubits of pasture lands around)
q: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

s: sons of Zadok receive land of Israel (place for their houses and for the sanctuary)
q: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the LORD.

s: sons of Zadok minister to the LORD (come near to minister)
q: who come near to minister to the LORD

s: Levites is a ministers of the house
q: shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house

s: east gate is shut on six working days (status on working days)
q: The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days

s: new moon has prince burnt offering young bull, six lambs, and a ram (without defect)
q: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram.

s: meal offering has amount for ram ephah (with a hin of oil to an ephah)
q: the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

s: prince leaves by porch of the gate (same way he entered)
q: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.

s: people of the land exit by opposite gate (at appointed feasts; enter north leave south and vice versa)
q: He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

s: prince goes in and out with people of the land (at appointed feasts)
q: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

s: east gate is opened for free will offering (when the prince prepares one; shut after he leaves)
q: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to the LORD, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east

s: daily continual burnt offering consists of lamb a year old (without defect, prepared every morning)
q: You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

s: daily continual burnt offering has meal offering sixth part of an ephah (with a third of a hin of oil)
q: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour

s: daily continual burnt offering has duration perpetual (ordinance)
q: a meal offering to the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance.

s: prince's inheritance laws provide that gift to sons permanent inheritance (belongs to his sons)
q: If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons.

s: east gate is opened on Sabbath (status on Sabbath)
q: on the Sabbath day it shall be opened

s: prince's inheritance laws provide that gift to servants returns to prince in year of liberty (servant's gift is temporary)
q: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince

s: prince's inheritance laws forbid taking the people's inheritance (prince gives sons from his own possession)
q: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession.

s: holy rooms (north and south rooms) faces north
q: into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north

s: holy rooms (north and south rooms) is used for boiling trespass and sin offerings and baking meal offering (so as not to sanctify the people in outer court)
q: This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.

s: corner courts located in outer court (one in every corner)
q: in every corner of the court there was a court.

s: corner courts has size forty cubits long and thirty wide (all four the same size)
q: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

s: corner courts has part boiling places (under the walls all around)
q: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

s: boiling houses is used by ministers of the house (to boil the people's sacrifice)
q: These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

s: east gate is opened on new moon (status on new moon)
q: on the day of the new moon it shall be opened

s: east gate remains open until evening (after the prince goes out)
q: the gate shall not be shut until the evening

s: prince enters by porch of the gate outside (east gate of the inner court)
q: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate

s: prince worships at threshold of the gate (east gate)
q: he shall worship at the threshold of the gate

s: priests (of the temple) prepare for prince burnt offering (also peace offerings)
q: the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings

s: people of the land worship at east gate (at its door, on Sabbaths and new moons)
q: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

s: Sabbath has prince burnt offering six lambs and a ram (without defect)
q: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to the LORD shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

s: river (flowing from the temple) flows from the temple (from under the threshold, eastward)
q: waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward

s: trees (along the river) has use fruit for food, leaf for healing
q: Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

s: the sea (Dead Sea) will have great multitude of fish (once healed)
q: Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there

s: the sea (Dead Sea) has fishing area En Gedi to En Eglaim (place for spreading nets)
q: From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets.

s: the sea (Dead Sea) has part swamps and marshes (not healed, given up to salt)
q: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

s: Ezekiel (son of man) is addressed as Son of man
q: “Son of man, have you seen this?”

s: the man with the measuring reed (guide) guides Ezekiel (son of man) (measuring the waters)
q: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters

s: the LORD swore to give land to land of Israel (to Israel's fathers)
q: for I swore to give it to your fathers.

s: land of Israel is divided among Israel (twelve tribes; Joseph has two portions)
q: This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

s: land of Israel is divided by lot (among Israelites and aliens)
q: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you

s: aliens (strangers among Israel) has status as native-born (among the children of Israel)
q: Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel.

s: the temple faces east
q: for the front of the temple faced toward the east

s: aliens (strangers among Israel) receives inheritance (in the tribe where they live)
q: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,”

s: borders of the land has east border Jordan
q: the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

s: borders of the land has west border the great sea (Mediterranean)
q: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath.

s: borders of the land has south border Tamar (to Meriboth Kadesh, the brook, the great sea)
q: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

s: borders of the land has north border Hethlon (from the great sea toward Zedad, Hamath, Hazar Enon)
q: On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

s: river (flowing from the temple) flows into the sea (Dead Sea) (via the Arabah)
q: These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

s: river (flowing from the temple) has depth too deep to cross (after four thousand cubits)
q: it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

s: river (flowing from the temple) gives life to every living creature (wherever the river comes)
q: everything will live wherever the river comes.

s: river (flowing from the temple) heals the sea (Dead Sea)
q: the waters of the sea will be healed

s: trees (along the river) grow along river (flowing from the temple) (on both banks)
q: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food

s: trees (along the river) has leaf property does not wither (leaf used for healing)
q: whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail.

s: trees (along the river) produces new fruit every month (because its waters issue out of the sanctuary)
q: It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary.

s: Dan is a tribe (receives one portion)
q: Dan, one portion.

s: Benjamin borders Judah (separated by the prince's land and the offering)
q: between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

s: Judah has gate gate of Judah (north side of the city)
q: the gate of Judah, one;

s: Joseph has gate gate of Joseph (east side of the city)
q: even the gate of Joseph, one;

s: Dan located at north end (northernmost portion beside Hamath)
q: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

s: priests is a sons of Zadok (sanctified priests who kept the LORD's instruction)
q: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

s: priests owns holy offering (twenty-five thousand by ten thousand reeds)
q: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length;

s: sons of Zadok has trait faithful (did not go astray when Israel went astray)
q: who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

s: Dan has gate the gate of Dan (one)
q: the gate of Dan, one.

s: Levites has trait went astray (when Israel went astray)
q: as the Levites went astray.

s: Levites owns land (twenty-five thousand cubits by ten thousand, alongside the priests' border)
q: Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width.

s: Levites has restriction may not sell or exchange their land (because it is holy to the LORD)
q: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD.

s: holy offering has size 25,000 by 25,000 reeds (whole offering including the city's possession)
q: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand.

s: holy offering contains sanctuary (in the holy portion) (in the middle of it)
q: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.

s: holy offering borders Judah (lies by Judah's border)
q: By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width

s: holy offering is offered to the LORD
q: The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

s: sanctuary (in the holy portion) belongs to the LORD
q: the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.

s: city has use common use (for dwelling and pasture lands)
q: shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

s: city has shape square (4,500 reeds on each side)
q: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

s: Asher borders Dan (portion adjoining Dan)
q: By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

s: city has pasture lands 250 reeds on each side (north, south, east, west)
q: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

s: city has circumference 18,000 reeds
q: It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference;

s: city has name The LORD is there (from that day)
q: and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘The LORD is there.’

s: city is cultivated by those who labor in the city (out of all the tribes of Israel)
q: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

s: workers of the city is member of tribes of Israel (drawn from all the tribes)
q: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

s: prince owns remainder of the land (on both sides of the holy offering and city possession)
q: The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city;

s: land of Israel is divided by lot (among the tribes of Israel for inheritance)
q: This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord GOD.

s: tribal portions has shape strips from east side to west side
q: from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

s: Judah borders Reuben (portion adjoining Reuben)
q: By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

s: Ezekiel is a son of man (how the LORD addresses him)
q: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

s: bread (mixed-grain bread) is eaten by Ezekiel (for 390 days)
q: According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

s: siege of Jerusalem (tile depiction) is a sign to the house of Israel
q: This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

s: siege of Jerusalem (tile depiction) has component forts, mound, camps, battering rams (set all around Jerusalem)
q: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

s: the LORD will break staff of bread in Jerusalem (people will eat bread by weight and drink water by measure)
q: Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem.

s: the LORD will drive out house of Israel (among the nations, where they eat bread unclean)
q: Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.

s: Jerusalem is subject of siege of Jerusalem (tile depiction) (portrayed on a tile)
q: portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

s: iniquity (of Israel and Judah) has duration 390 years for Israel (appointed as a number of days)
q: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days.

s: Ezekiel bears iniquity (of Israel and Judah) (as a sign, by lying on his sides)
q: you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

s: Ezekiel lies on left side for 390 days (bearing the iniquity of the house of Israel)
q: According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

s: Ezekiel lies on right side for 40 days (bearing the iniquity of the house of Judah, each day for a year)
q: you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

s: Ezekiel has status not polluted (from his youth up, never eaten what dies of itself or is torn)
q: Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals.

s: Ezekiel has ration of bread twenty shekels a day (by weight, during the siege days)
q: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day.

s: Ezekiel has ration of water sixth part of a hin (by measure)
q: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin.

s: bread (mixed-grain bread) contains wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt (put in one vessel)
q: Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it.

s: bread (mixed-grain bread) is baked with dung (cow's dung substituted for man's dung)
q: Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.

s: Jerusalem located in nations (set in the middle of the nations)
q: This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

s: hair (the prophet's hair) is divided into three parts (burned, struck with sword, scattered to the wind)
q: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind

s: hair (the prophet's hair) symbolizes Jerusalem (sign-act; explained as 'This is Jerusalem')
q: This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations

s: famine is a evil arrow of destruction (sent by God)
q: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction

s: famine is part of God's judgment and wrath (a third will be consumed by famine)
q: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you.

s: sword (the sword of judgment) is part of God's judgment and wrath (a third will fall by the sword)
q: A third part will fall by the sword around you.

s: God's judgment and wrath results in reproach among nations (a taunt, instruction and astonishment)
q: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you

s: God's judgment and wrath is unprecedented never done before nor again (because of abominations)
q: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

s: Jerusalem rebels against the LORD (his ordinances and statutes, more than the nations)
q: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her

s: Jerusalem has attribute turbulent (more than the surrounding nations)
q: Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you

s: Jerusalem has attribute defiled the sanctuary (with detestable things and abominations)
q: you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations

s: Jerusalem is target of God's judgment and wrath (will become a desolation and reproach among nations)
q: Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

s: nations has attribute rejected God's ordinances (as stated of the surrounding countries)
q: for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.

s: the LORD is opposed to Jerusalem (will execute judgments in sight of the nations)
q: Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

s: the LORD owns the temple (called 'my sanctuary')
q: you have defiled my sanctuary

s: Ezekiel is addressed as son of man (instructed to take a sharp sword)
q: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword.

s: the LORD will bring sword (against the mountains of Israel)
q: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

s: remnant (of Israel) will be scattered among nations (as escapees from the sword)
q: you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

s: remnant (of Israel) will remember the LORD (while captive among the nations)
q: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive

s: remnant (of Israel) will loathe abominations and defilement of the sanctuary (loathe themselves for their evils)
q: Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

s: slain (of Israel) will lie before idols (Israel's idols) (dead bodies laid before them)
q: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols.

s: Israel has disposition lewd heart departed from God (plays the prostitute after idols)
q: their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols.

s: abominations and defilement of the sanctuary is evil (cause of coming judgment)
q: because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

s: sword, famine, and pestilence strikes Israel (far off by pestilence, near by sword, besieged by famine)
q: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine.

s: the LORD will destroy high places (of Israel)
q: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

s: the LORD will leave remnant (of Israel) (those who escape the sword among the nations)
q: Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

s: the LORD will make desolate land of Israel (from the wilderness toward Diblah)
q: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations.

s: Ezekiel is commanded to prophesy to the mountains of Israel (set his face toward them)
q: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

s: mountains of Israel is addressed by the LORD (as recipient of prophecy of judgment)
q: You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD!

s: high places (of Israel) will become desolate
q: the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate

s: idols (Israel's idols) will be broken
q: your idols may be broken and cease

s: the LORD judges land of Israel (according to its ways)
q: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways.

s: the end (coming doom) falls on land of Israel (on its four corners)
q: An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

s: abominations and iniquity are brought on inhabitants of Israel (as judgment)
q: I will bring on you all your abominations.

s: inhabitants of Israel will be unable to be saved by silver and gold (in the day of the LORD's wrath)
q: Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath.
